text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's first three years came to an end,
and a little time passed—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: “—Today, we have an active Umamusume who graduated from this club and a Trainer from Tracen Academy visiting us.”

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
It's a valuable opportunity,
so let's make sure to learn as much as we can from it.

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, think nothing of it, think nothing of it.
I shall even teach you how to run on dirt!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Hey, pull yourself together.
You trying to drag Waltz's name through the mud?

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Um, Bubble Gum Fellow!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I really, really look up to Bubble-san's running...!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My dream is to enter Tracen Academy someday and achieve a historic first, just like Bubble-san!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Me too! Just like Bubble-san, I want to be the strongest at my own specialty distance!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
I'm glad to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone's letting their dreams grow, huh.
choice_data_list: Well then, let's flesh it out even more.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice!
So what should we start with?
choice_data_list: When you think of something that expands an Umamusume's dreams, it would be—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —There's only one, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Cure, Lapis.
Let's run in front of everyone!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd say that.
That's just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Time to show 'em what we've got!
The running of the "Four Heavenly Kings"!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: —In that case, perhaps I should run for the first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Coach Waltz, you're going to run too!?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Because an opportunity like this rarely comes along.
If it's a short distance, I'll be fine too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: All 'Four Heavenly Kings' assembled after so long! Things are getting wild...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer.
Time for the start, let's go!
...Bubble Gum Fellow runs again today.
To let new dreams blossom—
